title: 第23章 炼制筑基丹第24章 土神涧
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: “哥哥……你……你真是妹妹的福星……”
洛彦的声音充满了依恋和一丝颤抖，
看向姚德龙的目光，充满了发自内心的爱慕和……崇拜！
这个男人，简直如同一个深不可测的宝藏！
“洛妹妹，我今日来，主要还是丹药之事。”
姚德龙轻轻拍了拍洛彦光滑的脊背。
洛彦闻言，立刻坐起身，丝毫不避讳自己春光外泄，
脸上瞬间切换成无比热情的笑容，甚至带着一丝讨好；
“哥哥的丹药，妹妹可是望眼欲穿！
还是暴灵丹？”
姚德龙点点头，取出两个玉瓶：“完美品质七十颗，上等品质二十颗。”
洛彦接过玉瓶，神识一扫，脸上顿时露出狂喜之色！
这成色，还是一如既往的好，甚至还多了一丝火属性的狂暴能量！
而且数量如此之多！
有了这批丹药，又能大赚一笔！
“哥哥！”
洛彦的声音甜得发腻，抓住姚德龙的手，
“妹妹做主了！
从今往后，哥哥炼制的完美暴灵丹，按四百下品灵石一颗收购！
上等的，按两百！
这是妹妹的诚意！
哥哥可千万别把丹药再给别人了！”
她伸出四根葱白玉指，语气带着一丝紧张和期待。
四百？！
两百？！
姚德龙心中也是一惊！
这洛彦是被灌迷魂汤了？
她这精明的商人，何时变得如此大方了？
看来我这炼丹师的身份，在她心中已经飙升到了极高的位置。
他面不改色，点点头：“妹妹厚谊，老夫记下了。”
洛彦顿时笑面如花，立刻取出灵石：七十颗完美，两万八千下品灵石（折算280中品）；
二十颗上等，四千下品灵石（折算40中品），共计320块中品灵石！
“另外，”
姚德龙收起灵石袋，“老夫需要十份炼制筑基丹的材料，品质要最好的。”
洛彦此刻对姚德龙的要求可谓有求必应，立刻亲自去库房调配。
很快，十个装满了各种珍稀灵药、灵露的玉盒摆在了姚德龙面前。
“哥哥，这是最好的十份材料，成本价，只需二十块中品灵石！”
洛彦殷勤地说道。
姚德龙爽快付账。
药材到手！
“哥哥炼制筑基丹，若有成品，可一定优先考虑妹妹这里哦！”
洛彦送姚德龙出门，倚在门框上，眼神拉丝，依依不舍。
content_en:
"Brother... you... you are really my sister's lucky star..."
Luo Yan's voice was full of attachment and a little trembling,
The eyes he looked at Yao Delong were filled with heartfelt love and... adoration!
This man is like an unfathomable treasure!
"Sister Luo, the main reason why I came here today is about the elixir."
Yao Delong gently patted Luo Yan's smooth back.
When Luo Yan heard this, he immediately sat up and did not shy away from leaking his love.
His face instantly switched to an extremely enthusiastic smile, even with a hint of ingratiation;
"My sister is eager to see through my brother's elixir!
Or a violent elixir? "
Yao Delong nodded and took out two jade bottles: "Seventy of perfect quality and twenty of high quality."
Luo Yan took the jade bottle, glanced at it with his consciousness, and his face suddenly showed a look of ecstasy!
The quality is still as good as ever, and it even has a hint of violent fire-attribute energy!
And there are so many!
With this batch of pills, you can make a lot of money again!
"Brother!"
Luo Yan's voice was so sweet that he grabbed Yao Delong's hand.
“Sister makes the decision!
From now on, the perfect violent elixir refined by my brother will be purchased for four hundred low-grade spiritual stones!
For the best ones, two hundred!
This is my sister’s sincerity!
Brother, please don’t ever give the elixir to anyone else again! "
She stretched out four green-white jade fingers, her tone filled with a hint of nervousness and expectation.
Four hundred? !
two hundred? !
Yao Delong was also shocked!
Has Luo Yan been fed ecstasy?
When did she, a shrewd businesswoman, become so generous?
It seems that my status as an alchemist has soared to a very high position in her heart.
His expression remained unchanged and he nodded: "Sister, I have written down your kindness."
Luo Yan suddenly smiled like a flower, and immediately took out the spiritual stones: seventy perfect, twenty-eight thousand low-grade spiritual stones (converted to 280 medium-grade);
Twenty high-grade and four thousand low-grade spiritual stones (converted into 40 medium-grade spiritual stones), a total of 320 medium-grade spiritual stones!
"Also,"
Yao Delong put away the spirit stone bag, "I need ten materials for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill, and they must be of the best quality."
Luo Yan responded to Yao Delong's request at this moment and immediately went to the warehouse to make arrangements.
Soon, ten jade boxes filled with various rare elixirs and spiritual dew were placed in front of Yao Delong.
"Brother, these are the ten best materials. The cost price is only twenty mid-grade spiritual stones!"
Luo Yan said diligently.
Yao Delong paid the bill readily.
The medicinal materials are available!
"Brother is refining the Foundation Establishment Pill. If there is a finished product, he must give priority to my sister!"
Luo Yan saw Yao Delong out and leaned against the door frame, his eyes drawn, reluctant to leave.
